broadcasts.message: Issue #311: ruflo execution layer + project defaults. Workers: (ec0g)=architecture, (wuis)=security, (iyuf)=code-quality, (3lk3)=test-gaps. Key design: ruflo_load_defaults() reads .shipwright/defaults.json or ~/.shipwright/defaults.json, called from ruflo_init(). Variables: RUFLO_MAX_AGENTS, RUFLO_COST_BUDGET_MULTIPLIER, RUFLO_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TIMEOUT, RUFLO_LEARNING_BRIDGE, RUFLO_Q_LEARNING. Daemon activates ruflo within user template - no template switch. Stage-level ruflo_mode from template config. All existing templates work when ruflo absent.
